name: exportReportData
shortDescription: Generates and provides downloadable administrative reports in CSV or PDF format based on various metrics.
description:
Overview

Generates and provides downloadable reports (CSV/PDF) based on appointment, user, or communication metrics for administrators. This function aggregates data from various entities to produce comprehensive reports.

Intended use

Called by the admin dashboard UI when an administrator requests to generate and download a report. Parameters may include report type, date range, and format (CSV/PDF). It returns a file stream or a URL to the generated report.

Logic

  1. Validate the input parameters, ensuring a valid report type, date range, and format are specified.
  2. Based on the report type, query relevant entities such as Appointment, User, Message, or MedicalRecord using ctx.data.query.
  3. Aggregate and process the retrieved data according to the report requirements.
  4. Format the processed data into the requested output format (CSV or PDF).
  5. Store the generated report temporarily using ctx.files.save_content or similar, and generate a signed download URL using ctx.files.download_url.
  6. Audit-log the report generation with ctx.audit.log, including the report type and parameters.
  7. Return the download URL for the generated report.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • User
  • Message
  • MedicalRecord
